Content: Classical Saju study (Ziping) treats the chart as a personality framework for reflection, not a fixed fate. It is used to think about your tendencies and friction points.

Content: Accurate charts adjust clock time to the sun's real position at your birth city (longitude and the equation of time). Near the edge of a two-hour block this can change the hour pillar.
Source: True Solar Time in Bazi: When Correction Changes a Pillar; BaziInsight hour pillar guide
